title: sproutboard-rollout-handoff-2027-03-23
content:
Meeting: Sproutboard rollout handoff (weekly sync)
Date: 2027-03-23
Owners: Maya Chen (notes), Ethan Park (ui), Aisha Rahman (analytics), Diego Alvarez (rollout ops)
Attendees: Maya, Ethan, Aisha, Diego, Priya, Sam (SRE drop-in)

TL;DR
- Small targeted canary tomorrow morning at 09:00 PT: 1% -> 5% if no errors; full 25% by Friday contingent on telemetry.
- Telemetry events need a quick patch: missing panel_open_reason field for fallback flows (INF-8741).
- UX tweak for button spacing merged but visual regression on IE/edge polyfill; hold off wide rollout until fix.

Current status by area
1) UI (Ethan)
- PR 1042 merged but reverted on Friday due to visual regression in narrow-window layout. Root cause: global css reset conflict with legacy panel styles.
- Plan: patch branch (hotfix/spacing) created, aim to cut PR by EOD 3/23, QA priority tomorrow morning.
- Risk: small fraction (0.2%) of customers use the legacy embed mode; regression affects them — consider scoped feature-flag rollout.
- TODO: add visual regression snapshot test for legacy embed (owner: Ethan, due: 2027-03-24).

2) Rollout & Ops (Diego)
- Canary schedule: 1% @ 09:00 -> wait 1h -> 5% -> 24h safe window -> 25% rollout if signal green.
- Fallback policy: if 5xx > 0.5% token/error rate OR latency p95 increases by >200ms, revert to previous model variant and UI flag off.
- Capacity check: dedicated pool has spare capacity for canary; SRE to monitor GPU mem_pressure alert for first 2 hours post-canary.
- Action: Diego to publish canary plan in #console-rollouts and tag SRE rotation (owner: Diego, due: 2027-03-23 17:00 PT).

3) Analytics & Telemetry (Aisha)
- Missing event field: panel_open_reason not being emitted for fallback path (reported in INF-8741). Without it we can’t disambiguate manual toggles vs automatic fallback.
- Quick fix: instrumentation patch in console events package, PR branch analytics/panel-reason-fix. Needs tiny schema bump (events_v2 -> events_v2b) and downstream consumer (metrics pipeline) update.
- Impact: if delayed, we risk overreacting to normal fallback noise during canary.
- Action: Aisha to PR analytics patch + coordinate with infra to deploy schema change to staging by 3/24. Notify data-platform.

Open blockers and questions
- Q1: Do we want to gate the legacy embed users behind an explicit FF for the next 2 weeks? Pros: avoids regression blast radius. Cons: fragmentation and extra complexity in rollouts. (Decision needed by 2027-03-24).
- Q2: Can we relax the latency threshold for the first 1h of canary to avoid noisy alerts from cold starts? SRE opinion required. Sam to advise.
- Blocker: analytics pipeline will need a small consumer mapping update; data-platform has limited off-hours bandwidth — need to prioritize.

Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider adding a temporary telemetry tag "sprout_canary_v1" to group events across system (console, serving runtime, metric). Keep TTL 30d.
- Handshake with model routing: ensure that fallback to cheaper model doesn't change output shape that UI expects. Diego to double-check compatibility matrix.

Decision log (quick)
- Decided: Hold wide release until UI hotfix + telemetry patch. Canary proceeds tomorrow but scoped to traffic not using legacy embed by default.
- Decided: Lower initial canary to 0.5% if SRE flags cold-start noise; otherwise 1% as planned.

Action items (owner -> task -> due)
- Ethan -> patch hotfix branch + add visual snapshot test -> 2027-03-24 11:00 PT
- Aisha -> PR telemetry patch + notify data-platform for consumer update -> 2027-03-24 09:00 PT
- Diego -> publish canary playbook to Slack and tag SRE rotation -> 2027-03-23 17:00 PT
- Maya -> update Confluence rollout checklist with new telemetry requirement and decision rationale -> 2027-03-24 12:00 PT
- Priya -> run a quick UX smoke on staging embed flows (legacy + new) and post screenshots -> 2027-03-24 10:00 PT

Follow-ups for next sync (2027-03-25)
- Confirm telemetry is emitting new panel_open_reason field and data-platform mapping is live.
- Check visual regression snapshots for legacy embed and confirm FF gating strategy.
- Canary metrics review: p95 latency, 5xx/error token rate, adoption per client-id (top 10).

Misc notes / references
- Related JIRA: INF-8723 (sproutboard feature flagging), INF-8741 (telemetry missing field)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1042
- Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Panel+Rollout+Playbook (section: scoped-canary)
- Slack: #console-rollouts, #sre-rotation

Quick raw scribbles (informal)
- "If legacy users are <1% of traffic maybe just FF them off for 2 weeks"
- "Data-platform slow but if we give good doc they usually squeeze a fast mapping"
- "Sam says p95 blips might be cold-start — add metric for cold_start=true on first token"

End of notes
